lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I received the seedling that you sent me.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Given that it's from the surface, it's in impeccable condition.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I've already sent it to my partner.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: He intends to place it in a greenhouse and make some improvements to it.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Remember what I told you about it having medicinal properties?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: They're going to try and maximize its medicinal potential.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: If a medicinal revolution ever occurs on the Ark in the near future,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: it will be thanks to our contributions.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: If things go well and you become a millionaire,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: you may finally be on my level.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: When that happens, I'll invite you to one of my parties.
